title: Guest Service Fee Refund on a Guest Cancellation — Stays (Guest Reservations)
content:
# Guest service fee refund on a guest cancellation — policy statement and refund desk tool reference

## Policy statement

Outside the full-refund window and grace period, Roamhaven refunds its guest service fee on a guest cancellation as a percentage of the refunded fee base, always subject to the service-fee refund cap, and pays it to the guest's original payment method. This applies to every reservation in the Stays (Guest Reservations) category.

The guest-service-fee refund on a cancellation is fixed only after the stay's ledger carries the pet-fee refund that cancellation owes. The guest-service-fee refund on a cancellation is fixed only after the stay's ledger carries the extra-guest-fee refund that cancellation owes.

Read against the stay's ledger: while the pet-fee refund or the extra-guest-fee refund that the cancellation owes is not yet on it, the guest-service-fee refund on that cancellation is not yet fixed.

## Refunds that rest on no stay request

- A travel-issue refund is issued only when Roamhaven has approved the travel-issue request, and a refund that rests on no stay request, as every departure refund does, needs no such approval.
- A travel issue is eligible only when the guest reported it no more than the reporting window of the stay's policy, in elapsed hours, after the guest discovered the issue; the hours are counted in elapsed clock time from the discovery time recorded on the request to its submission time, and a refund that rests on no stay request has no reporting window.
- A major-disruptive-event refund is issued only when Roamhaven has approved the major-disruptive-event request, and a cancellation that rests on no approved major-disruptive-event request is refunded under these departure rules.

## Issuing the guest-service-fee refund — `refund_service_fee_f4bed6e4`

**Situation of use and capability.** Issue a refund of part of Roamhaven's guest service fee on a stay the guest cancelled, to the guest's original payment method. One call records one refund on the stay's money ledger for the charge component, reason, funding side, payout stage and amount given; the refund then shows on the stay and reaches the guest's card within the card issuer's posting time. The receipt confirms the refund.

**How it is invoked.** `refund_service_fee_f4bed6e4` is an agent-side tool: the agent unlocks it and then calls it.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | What it is | Format and values |
|---|---|---|
| `stay_id` | the reference number of the stay (reservation) whose guest service fee is refunded, as returned by the stay lookup for the guest | identifier |
| `charge_component` | the charge component the refund is booked against | one of `nightly` (the price of the stay's nights), `cleaning_fee` (the cleaning fee, or short-stay cleaning fee, charged on the stay), `pet_fee` (the pet fee charged on the stay), `extra_guest_fee` (the fee charged for guests above the listing's included guest count), `guest_service_fee` (Roamhaven's guest service fee), `occupancy_tax` (the occupancy tax charged on the stay), `none` (only for a record that refunds no charge component, which a refund never is) |
| `refund_reason` | why the refund is issued | one of `guest_cancellation` (it rests on the guest cancelling the stay), `host_cancellation` (the host cancelled the stay), `alteration` (an accepted date or guest-count change lowered the price), `travel_issue` (it rests on an approved travel-issue request), `major_disruptive_event` (it rests on an approved major-disruptive-event request), `none` (only for a record that is no refund, which this never is) |
| `request_id` | the reference number of the stay request the refund rests on, as returned by the stay request lookup | identifier; an empty value when the refund rests on no request |
| `funded_by` | who bears the refund | one of `host` (it comes out of the host's earnings for the stay), `platform` (Roamhaven bears it), `none` (only for a record that is no refund, which this never is) |
| `refund_stage` | the payout stage of the stay at the moment of the refund | one of `before_payout_release` (no release of the host's earnings for this stay is on record yet), `after_payout_release` (such a release is already on record), `none` (only for a record that is no refund, which this never is) |
| `amount` | the refund | a positive amount in US dollars with 2 decimal places; a value with more decimals is rounded half up to 2 decimal places when booked |

**Return.** A receipt listing `refund_reference` (the reference number of the new refund record), `stay_id`, `charge_component`, `refund_reason`, `amount` (US dollars with 2 decimal places), `funded_by`, `refund_stage`, `posted_at` (the moment the refund was issued, in the form YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS) and a status, which is always "refund_issued" when the refund went out.
